query:
SELECT
                            l.hostname,
                            l.mode::text,
                            l.worker_group,
                            l.log_ts,
                            l.file_path,
                            l.ok_lines,
                            l.err_lines,
                            l.json_fmt
                        FROM log_file l
                        JOIN unnest($1::text[], $2::timestamp[]) AS c(hostname, log_ts)
                          ON l.hostname = c.hostname AND l.log_ts = c.log_ts
                        ORDER BY l.log_ts ASC
